cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Put It Back Quietly
cards.instruction: Return something you misplaced, used, or damaged without revealing why it needed restoring.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Sunday lunch is under control. Your plate's back in the cupboard, and I'll set the table.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That plate has flowers. Our set is plain.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll take the flowers. You can choose my place; I'll keep it discreet under the potatoes.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I don't want it hidden. I want six matching plates on the table.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A matching set, absolutely. I'll get five more flowered ones before lunch. You arrange them; I'll pack the plain ones away. No need to count the spares.

reason: Have A quietly yield table appearance and arrangement to B while expanding the restoration and steering attention away from the old plate count.
